subject: Data homing evidence & tenant scrub plan for dedicated EU deployment
messages:
From: Anika Bose <anika.bose@meditrust.com>

Cc: security@meditrust.com, Procurement Team <procurement@meditrust.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 20:08:00 +0000
Subject: Request: final artefacts for EU-only homing + scrub acceptance criteria

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the dedicated EU deployment looks promising. Before we move to a purchase order, Security and Procurement need a compact bundle of evidence and an operational scrub plan we can sign off on. Can you provide the following: 

- Confirmation that all active & backup copies for our tenant will be stored in EU-only regions (no accidental cross-region snapshots)
- A short artifact that proves physical/host affinity for the tenant (snapshot IDs, host tags, or cluster IDs)
- The tenant scrub runbook and max RTO for a full tenant wipe (including how long encryption keys remain in backups)
- Example audit log export with timestamps that show a simulated tenant purge (or a recent wipe exercise)

We don't need full raw logs — a redacted CSV showing event types/timestamps + the scrub command invocation will suffice. Ideally by EOD Thursday (your local). If there are any constraints (e.g., backups retained for legal hold), call them out.

Appreciate it — we want to finish internal approvals next week.

Regards,
Anika Bose
Head of Security Operations
MediTrust Health

--

Hi Anika — thanks for the clear checklist. Looping in Dev (SRE lead) and Lauren (accounts/legal) so we can deliver the exact artifacts and timelines you need. High level: yes, we can guarantee EU-only residency for your dedicated tenant and provide a scrub runbook plus redacted audit evidence. Below is what we'll provide and when.

What we'll deliver (target: Thu EOD CET):
- region-homing-matrix.csv — mapping of tenant -> cluster IDs -> AZs (redacted host IDs)
- tenant-scrub-evidence.zip — contains wipe-runbook.md, redacted audit-log-export-20261209.csv, and a short activity log that shows a simulated tenant purge we ran in a staging mirror
- brief write-up on KMS key separation and backup encryption lifetime
- link to a read-only Drive folder with artifacts and a DocuSign link for the SLA exception (if needed)

Notes / constraints:
- Snapshots created for backups are configured with EU-only replication by policy; cross-region replication is disabled for this tenant class by default. We'll include snapshot metadata.
- Backups retained for legal-hold requests can extend beyond scrub windows; please confirm whether MediTrust has any archival legal holds that might require extended retention.

Next steps: Dev will upload the artifacts and a short technical note describing the scrub sequence. Lauren will prepare suggested contract language for the purge acceptance criteria. Can you confirm if Procurement needs any additional fields on the DocuSign (PO number, signatory name)?

Thanks — we'll get this over tomorrow.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Customer Reliability

Hi Anika / team — attaching the artifacts to the Drive link (see below). Quick technical summary and scrub proof notes included here for clarity.

Attachments (zipped in tenant-scrub-evidence.zip in the Drive folder):
- wipe-runbook.md — step-by-step commands we run for a full tenant scrub, including KV cache eviction, DB logical deletes, and physical snapshot deletion calls.
- region-homing-matrix.csv — tenant -> cluster -> AZ mapping (host ids redacted to the last 4 chars)
- audit-log-export-20261209.csv — redacted events showing the purge operation we executed in staging; columns: event_time, tenant_id, action, initiator, status

Technical highlights:
- Residency: Tenant is pinned to our EU-dedicated pool (cluster tag: eu-dedicated-01). All block storage snapshots and image backups for that cluster are created with a region-only flag; cross-region replication is explicitly disabled for eu-dedicated pools via policy id: policy-eu-2024-phi.
- Backups & keys: Backups are encrypted with a tenant-scoped KMS key (separate key per tenant). We include key metadata in region-homing-matrix.csv. Key material for your tenant is stored in an EU KMS region.
- Scrub sequence (high level): 1) place tenant in read-only maintenance, 2) flush and evict KV caches, 3) trigger logical DB wipe, 4) delete snapshots and /request/ async physical wipe from storage provider, 5) rotate and schedule KMS key destruction window. Our documented max RTO for a full scrub (including async provider wipe) is 72 hrs; typical completion is 24–48 hrs depending on provider window.
- Audit evidence: audit-log-export-20261209.csv shows a simulated wipe in staging at 2026-12-09T11:22:00Z with status COMPLETED. We redacted internal host identifiers.

Drive link with artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-homing-evidence
DocuSign (SLA exception template): https://docusign.com/MT-SLA-EXCEPTION-2026

If you want, we can also produce a signed attestation PDF from our compliance team summarizing the verification steps. Lauren — looping you for the contract language.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
SRE Lead, Dedicated Platforms
Redwood Inference
